title: Agent Files Index: features of public AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and SKILL.md files
description: Structural features of agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, SKILL.md) in public GitHub repositories: a census of repos with 1,000 or more stars pushed in the 12 months to 15 November 2026, and a self-weighting 5% day sample of repos with 100 to 999 stars. Derived features only, no file text. Includes agentfiles, a lint checker (MIT) whose rules come from the data and from published guidance.
